scope: One common native matter, field and per-vertex capacity source, with actual preparations, faithful references, complete instruments and physical attachments.

stages.domain: The finite CCF-LT-2 graph family, with 96 native CAR modes per vertex, integer electric links, and the independent per-vertex local-capacity response law.
acceptance: Retain the actual 114-factor, 22273-term parent snapshot and calibrated binary coefficients; reproduce its exact two-cell polynomial before spatial replication.
Generate the signed charged and neutral Dirac kinetic, complete current-square interactions and quark-family shifts on the full Fock carrier, with all constants and adjoints.
Fix graph orientation, hard-wall products, h_v/g_v allocation, independent per-vertex capacities, e_v and common F references and source time before execution.

stages.title: Prepare the physical state with its boundary charges
stages.domain: Declared preparations, retained charge references and the faithful beta=1/1024 Gibbs family on the complete Gauss-zero cap6 support; arbitrary native propagation is not asserted.
acceptance: Declare each preparation and its charge reference on the actual complete carrier; keep every native complement and preparation failure.
Keep Gauss preparation and its retained syndrome history separate from exp(-i tau H_v2).
Prove reduction before using a compressed sector. Local geometry couples neutral stress, so independent neutral spectators cannot be assumed.
Count the complete Gauss-zero support and retain all 48^|V| geometry factors in the adopted beta=1/1024 Gibbs reference; do not identify it as an efficiently prepared physical vacuum.

stages.title: Control local dynamics and complete instruments
stages.domain: Full native polynomial and local-capacity basis columns, exact initial complete phase instrument, and separate complete finite field, Dirac and geometry diagnostics.
acceptance: Check Hermiticity, local Gauss identities, source-derived phase current and response contacts, exact shard summation and complete local-capacity basis columns.
Retain every measurement outcome and meter work in each complete finite diagnostic, together with wrong-link, wrong-face and zero-coupling controls.
Keep master-source propagation distinct from polynomial generation and column application; calculate its complete observer histories before making that claim.
Retain all three phase-PVM outcomes and the full initial native column; initial derivatives do not establish finite-time native propagation.

stages.title: Take one state and correlation limit
stages.domain: A common angular/radial, matter, field-cutoff, geometry, clock and reference refinement for H_v2.
acceptance: Use the angular/radial shrinking shell and exact chain maps; construct compatible local observables, states, retained references and complete instruments.
Control interacting energy and correlation tails, hard-wall cutoff products, response errors and parameter scaling together; a geometric cell-diameter bound does not prove these limits.
Retain all calibration ancestry and prove convergence for one admitted observation menu and source.

stages.title: Reconstruct a nontrivial interacting relativistic field
stages.domain: Interacting matter, electromagnetic field and geometry records on one Lorentzian physical interpretation.
acceptance: Attach the same source clock, propagation, proper volume, area and detector records to one metric and physical scale.
Prove nonfree relativistic correlation/record limits, including species, Wilson regulator and mirror control; exact mass/alpha anticommutation is a finite compatibility result.
The separate smooth scalar finite-menu theorem retains its stated source and readout hypotheses; instantiate their joint charged counterpart explicitly.

stages.title: Attach chiral matter, species and any claimed defects
stages.domain: Actual dressed native currents and charged/neutral lepton plus colour-family operators on H_v2.
acceptance: Identify physical currents, spin, statistics, families and chiral species from complete source records, preserving antiparticles and interband terms.
Control the Wilson regulator, mirrors, gauge phase and neutrino identification on the same interacting source.
Internal weights and nonzero current-square conversion vertices alone do not identify physical particles or outgoing decay shells.

stages.title: Calculate the full spectrum and its interactions
stages.domain: Same-source interacting vacuum, thresholds, inclusive channels, scattering and decay records.
acceptance: Compute the actual interacting reference and complete spectral measures, residues and energy shells under H_v2.
A nonzero native pair/flux matrix element is a channel statement, not an on-shell photon or decay rate. Quantitative H_S time bounds require an additional proof before use for H_v2.
Recalculate spectra changed by the Dirac, weak, family and geometry terms; do not transfer number-conserving two-state arrival curves or Wilson-source masses.

stages.title: Compare independent observable records
stages.domain: Independent physical comparisons in one declared clock, energy, charge and geometry dictionary.
acceptance: Calibrate shared physical units, preparation, detector resolution and comparison scheme with propagated uncertainties.
Keep inherited calibration, rational couplings, family shifts/mixing and geometry potentials as supplied inputs; their targets are not independent predictions.
A pair gap 2m is measured as 2m. A stationary global phase is not a self-starting observable clock.

stages.title: Establish a pure Yang-Mills continuum gap on its own branch
stages.domain: A separately supplied pure compact-simple gauge source or proved decoupling/reducing map.
acceptance: Instantiate shared source, state, records, refinement and field nodes for the pure gauge source.
Apply the conditional dense local decay and noncollapse criterion with its actual reconstructed time.
A coupled source with a physical massless photon does not have a positive global vacuum gap.

stages.title: Recover proper geometry and Einstein dynamics
stages.domain: Matched regional entropy/area/stress estimates for the complete CCF-LT-2 energy response and one physical refinement.
acceptance: Use the six strain and three shift derivatives of the declared constant-coframe H_S family; establish their common Lorentz stress, momentum, boundary terms and physical metric interpretation.

Use the declared faithful finite reference supports; construct actual regional entropy/area readouts in ten common timelike probes and independently bound bulk, area and stationarity errors. The full-Gibbs diagonal-area shortcut fails its actual off-diagonal countervariation.
Use OPH.EinsteinBranch.Quantitative.small_ball_tensor_bound unchanged. Require all errors o(ell^4), eta converging to a common positive value, convergent tensors and geometry identified with G[g].
Apply Ward, Bianchi and metric compatibility for constant Lambda, then the same-residual Newton transfer. Physical G, Lambda and units are not selected by bounded geometry or capacity potentials.
